reviews.text: Jake and team were great. They treated our house with respect and got the job done in an efficient manner. We’ve used Mike’s for years and will continue to do so to keep our stoves in clean working order.
reviews.author: Derek H.

reviews.text: I've used Mike's Chimney Sweep for the last 5 years and am always impressed by their service. I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Chelsea C.

reviews.text: I always call Mikes Chimney Sweep to clean our flue liners, before the burning season. They are reliable, professional and their pricing is always fair. Jake, who normaly comes out is very knowledgeable. He's a pro at what he does.
reviews.author: Josh M.
